hero.title: Your team loses weeks a year on tasks an add-in solves in seconds.
hero.subtitle: C# add-ins for Civil 3D and Revit, Dynamo scripts, and training for BIM teams. A team of civil engineers and software engineers: we understand your workflow because we've lived it, and we know how to build the tool that fixes it.

differentiators.title: We're not one more drop in the ocean.
differentiators.subtitle: The English-speaking BIM ecosystem is full of Revit tutorials and generic automation agencies. We do something else: we build the tools, we work infrastructure, and we publish everything we learn.

items.title: Civil engineers + software engineers
items.body: You won't need to explain what a corridor, an assembly, or a site surface is: there are civil engineers on the team. And there are software engineers so the tool holds up in production. The diagnosis starts where others are still figuring out the problem.

items.title: C# add-ins, not just Dynamo
items.body: Most stop at visual scripting. We take automation all the way to an installable add-in: a button on the toolbar the whole team uses, with no graph editor to open.

items.title: Real Civil 3D expertise
items.body: Almost the entire ecosystem talks about Revit. We work infrastructure daily: corridors, surfaces, profiles, earthwork quantities, and survey points.

items.title: We publish what we know
items.body: Complete, free guides to the Revit API, the Civil 3D API, and Dynamo. If your team ends up maintaining the tool on its own, that's a win for everyone.

services.title: We automate the repetitive work your BIM team does by hand.
services.subtitle: From the script that validates an idea to the add-in the whole office installs.

items.title: Custom add-ins for Revit and Civil 3D
items.body: Plugin development in C# / .NET on Autodesk's official API. A dedicated toolbar button, an installer for the whole office, and version support.

items.title: Dynamo automation
items.body: Scripts and routines for modeling tasks, parametric geometry, and bulk processing. Fast to validate — ideal while the automation is still evolving.

items.title: BIM process audit
items.body: We measure where your team's hours actually go and hand you a prioritized plan: what to automate first, with which tool, and how much time you get back.

items.title: Courses and mentorship for BIM teams
items.body: Hands-on training in the Revit API, the Civil 3D API, and Dynamo — for teams that would rather build and maintain their own tools in-house.

process.title: From diagnosis to an installed add-in.
process.subtitle: A process built to avoid the most common mistake: writing code before knowing if it's worth it.

steps.title: Workflow diagnosis
steps.body: We look at your real process and measure where the hours go. You get a list prioritized by time saved versus effort.

steps.title: Dynamo prototype
steps.body: We validate the logic fast and cheap. If the team confirms it solves the problem, we move forward. If not, you just saved weeks of development.

steps.title: C# add-in
steps.body: We take it to production once usage justifies it: layered architecture, error handling, and performance on real models.

steps.title: Rollout and training
steps.body: An installer for the whole office, team training, and support when Autodesk ships the next version.
